BiblicalUsage: Habakkuk means embrace, and the prophet's name stands at the head of his burden and of his prayer. The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see opens the book, and his prayer upon Shigionoth closes it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe his name fits his book: a man who wrestled with God and ended by clinging to Him.
